summary_insights: Total revenue for the YTD period reached £4.51m, representing a 9.9% decline compared to the previous year's performance of £4.96m.
Gross profit margin remained relatively stable at 32.5% compared to 30.8% in the prior period, despite the drop in top-line turnover.
Net profit has seen a significant contraction of 70.1% year-on-year, falling from £272,961 to £160,506 (before tax).
Subcontractor costs remain a major component of the cost base, accounting for 29% of total turnover, though this is a slight improvement from 32% previously.
Overhead absorption has increased to 29% of turnover (up from 25%), primarily driven by a 26.6% increase in wage costs which rose to £724,993.
The business experienced extreme volatility in monthly performance, with net margins ranging from -173% in Nov-24 to +40% in Oct-25.
A significant bad debt provision of £10,267 was recognized in the final month of the period, impacting year-end profitability.
Overall financial resilience is weakened by the sharp decline in net margin, which now stands at just 1.3% after accounting for corporation tax.
